lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How might ChatGPT and similar models reshape daily life and productivity in the coming years?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Currently, ChatGPT can automate tasks like writing emails, coding, and content creation—boosting efficiency by hours daily.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But overreliance risks devaluing human skills and deepening inequality if access is uneven.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating guardrails, bias detection, and transparency tools to ensure responsible use.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI aids creativity, not replaces it—with equitable access and clear ethical boundaries.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future will balance innovation with responsibility, shaping a smarter, more inclusive world.

video_cue: A montage of people using AI tools for creative and productive tasks, with ethical guidelines displayed on-screen.
